meta.description.hr: Domaća spiza na drniškoj pjaci. Pršut, tripice, peka i sve šta ti duša poželi — kvalitetno, obilato i po normalnoj cieni.
meta.description.en: Homemade food on the Drniš market square. Pršut, tripe, peka and everything your heart desires — quality, generous portions, fair prices.

hero.tagline.en: Homemade food on the Drniš market square

about.text1.hr: Kod Baje se ide ist već pola vika. Na istom mistu, na drniškoj pjaci, di su se ljudi oduvijek nalazili, marendali i družili. Nama je ugostiteljstvo tradicija, a gostionica institucija!
about.text1.en: People have been coming to Baja's to eat for half a century. Same spot, on the Drniš market square, where folks have always gathered, shared a meal, and caught up. For us, hospitality is a tradition — and this restaurant is an institution.

about.text2.hr: Spiza mora bit kvalitetna, obilata i ne smi bit skupa. Kod nas idu ljudi koji radu cili dan — i kad dođeš, mora bit i dobro i obilato, jer čovik koji radi ogladni.
about.text2.en: The food has to be quality, generous, and affordable. Our regulars work hard all day — so when they sit down to eat, it better be good and plenty, because a working man gets hungry.

about.text3.hr: S ljudima je najlipše radit. Mi znamo na vrata kad ko dolazi, kakav je. I tako, mi s njima, oni s nama — pa dok bude išlo!
about.text3.en: Working with people is the best part. We know every face that walks through that door. That's how it goes — we're there for them, they're there for us. As long as it lasts!
